text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was hanging out in town with 
Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Movie theaters, cafes, and all sorts of 
shops... This town is quite delightful as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It's fun. It's fun—and yet...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Not as much as... Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—Furioso and I didn't come here 
today just to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when it comes to spending days off, 
no city beats Funabashi— I came here to 
confirm just that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This town is putting up quite a 
good effort, but when the rival is 
Funabashi—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well if it isn't Furio~!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Hm, if it isn't Tran-san and Falcon-san. 
Are you two heading out as well?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since we have the day off, I thought 
it'd be fun to visit each other's 
recommended spots~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
How about you two join in too? It's super 
fun~

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...What should we do, Trainer? This is 
practically—
choice_data_list:
...Sounds like a challenge to all of us 
from Funabashi.

...That's a challenge to those of us from 
Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. Shall we accept the challenge here?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well, either way, there's no way it'll be 
more interesting than Funabashi, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Wh... What is this place?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this place is pretty famous, y'know? 
It's a concept cafe with a steampunk vibe.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All the gadgets are steampunk-themed too. 
To order, you even type in the item 
numbers on a retro typewriter.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, a robot is delivering the food— Wait, 
did it just spew steam!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Heh~... I wonder if that also works as a 
humidifier. That's amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No! It's not as interesting compared 
to Funabashi, but...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"She's an idol Falco's been keeping an eye 
on lately. Come on, check her out...!"

text_block_list.name: Underground Idol
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah! 5.5 rotations around the Earth!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? She just pulled off a spin on 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! I'm not feeling it, not feeling it 
at all...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Today was so much fun☆

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... Do I have no choice but to admit 
it...? That I actually had fun...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. The carrot parfait I ordered is 
here.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...!? Th-This taste is...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Look right here on the menu! "Made 
with sweet, 
pride-of-the-manager's-hometown Funabashi 
carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Huh. What an unexpected surprise at the 
very end."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this is crazy delicious. Not bad at 
all, Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to go to Funabashi with 
everyone next time!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... it's not over yet...! 
Funabashi's overwhelming charm has so much 
more to offer!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how great Funabashi can 
be!
choice_data_list: I need to make a tour plan
I need to make a tour plan, don't I

I'll show them the true grit of 
Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how great Funabashi can 
be!
choice_data_list: I need to make a tour plan
I need to make a tour plan, don't I

I'll show them the true grit of 
Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As soon as we get back to the 
academy, we're having an MTG!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waaah, so authentic☆ I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Furioso, I swore that we 
would get our revenge (?) today, without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, precisely...! Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder. Did we just not know, and 
Funabashi is actually some kind of demon 
realm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—together with Furioso, she vowed to 
drag both of them down into the depths of 
Funabashi.
